name: Upper Moreland Supervised Playgrounds
operator_name: Upper Moreland Township Department of Parks and Recreation
street_address: Upper Moreland Intermediate and Middle School grounds
description_short: Township summer playground program for Upper Moreland residents entering grades 1 to 8, held at the Upper Moreland Intermediate School (grades 1 to 3) and Middle School (grades 4 to 8). Days mix sports, games, arts and crafts, on site shows and local trips, with optional swimming at the Middle School pool. Open to township residents only.

fees.name: Extended supervision
fees.note: Before care 7:30 to 8:30 a.m. or after care 4:30 to 5:30 p.m. for the 8 week session; $75 for either for a 4 week session. Held at the UM Primary School.

refund_policy_summary: Full refund through June 5 on return of the t-shirt and bag; during the first week of enrollment, the amount paid minus a prorated daily rate. Fees are not prorated for attendance. Online and in office card payments carry a 2.99% processing fee.
swim_waterfront_notes: Optional swimming at the UM Middle School pool on Monday or Friday mornings; deep end swimmers must pass a lifeguard swim test.

sessions.name: Full 8 weeks (no program June 19 and July 3; August 7 ends at noon)

notes: Open only to Upper Moreland Township residents entering grades 1 to 8; there is no nonresident rate. $1,500 for 8 weeks or $800 for either 4 week half, 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Sibling discount $50 (8 weeks) or $20 (4 weeks). A deposit of $500 (8 weeks) or $300 (4 weeks) per child is due at registration and counts toward the fee. All trip admissions and on site activities are included; some trips include lunch. Families drop off and pick up at the site; the township buses campers only to trips.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Supervised Playgrounds parent information packet, updated 6/9/2026, on the township's recreation site. Residents entering grades 1 to 8; ages derived from grades, not stated. Department office 117 Park Avenue, Willow Grove; the school sites' street addresses are not given.
